editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Octa is a legitimate forex broker scoring 6.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. Formerly known as OctaFX, the broker rebranded and secured CySEC regulation (Octa Markets Cyprus Ltd) for EU clients while maintaining FSA Seychelles for its massive international client base across Southeast Asia and Africa. The platform offers forex (35+ pairs), indices, commodities, crypto, and stocks CFDs through OctaTrader (proprietary with built-in copy trading), MT4, and MT5. The $25 minimum deposit is among the lowest available. Spreads from 0.6 pips with zero commission provide competitive pricing. The withdrawal speed reputation — particularly in Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Nigeria, and Kenya — is the genuine brand differentiator. But the Seychelles entity serving most clients worldwide offers no investor compensation scheme and leverage up to 1:500. If you are in SE Asia or Africa and fast withdrawals matter more than regulatory depth — Octa delivers on its core promise. If you need Tier-1 protection — look at brokers with FCA or ASIC licences.
